verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms React components manage their own local state (react-gh-1, react-docs-3), but nothing in the pack explicitly describes built-in primitives like Context/useReducer being used for *global* app-wide state management without libraries like Redux. missing for 10: explicit documentation of useContext/useReducer as a global-state solution, comparison to third-party state libraries, and independent confirmation this pattern is commonly used in production.
